summary: 8/8 browser checks passed. No API-bearing criteria found — all interactive data (Garage, Ownership, Pitstop, Membership) is local React state per spec, so no backend test files were created.

checks.name: homepage-editorial-only
checks.evidence: MagazineHome renders header/hero/article-grid/featured/footer; tools-garage-section, tools-ownership-section, tools-livery-section, pitstop-forum-feed all assert toHaveCount(0) on '/'.

checks.criterion: Article archive is complete and interactive
checks.name: archive-search-filter-and-detail-nav
checks.evidence: 7 archive cards rendered; search 'tire' narrows to 1 (tire-tech-2026); category filter narrows count between 1 and 6; clicking read-link navigates to /articles/tire-tech-2026 (article-page visible).

checks.name: article-detail-elements-and-navigation
checks.evidence: article-hero-image, article-category, article-title, article-dek, article-author, article-published, article-read-time, article-copy all visible; mode toggle changes article-mode-label text; back-to-magazine link and logo link both return to magazine-home-page.

checks.criterion: Tools hub preserves all requested tools
checks.name: tools-hub-garage-calculator-livery
checks.evidence: Selected tenere + cfmoto -> comparison sheet shows 'Ténéré 700' and 'CFMoto 450 MT'; changing daily-km/efficiency inputs updates tools-monthly-cost-value; orange swatch sets silhouette background-color rgb(255,102,0) and current-livery label; windshield toggle adds 'masked' class.

checks.criterion: Pitstop has a detailed standalone community page
checks.name: pitstop-filters-upvote-and-post
checks.evidence: 4 seeded posts; DAILY GRIND filter reduces visible count (>0, <4); upvote on post 1 increments votes text by 1; submitting compose form with fixture title 'tscheck-new-discussion-<ts>' adds a 5th post visible in feed.

checks.name: membership-nav-and-plan-join
checks.evidence: magazine-navigation contains MEMBERSHIP link and text does not contain 'SHOP'; default selected plan is membership-plan-grid (Grid Member, has 'selected' class); selecting Factory Spec updates selected-plan heading to 'FACTORY SPEC'; Join the Line button flips to 'MEMBERSHIP ACTIVE' and copy contains 'active'.

checks.criterion: Track and Street modes remain operational
checks.name: track-street-mode-toggle-across-pages
checks.evidence: magazine-mode-toggle flips track-mode/street-mode class on magazine-home-page, tools-page, pitstop-page, and membership-page in turn (each page holds its own local mode state, default track-mode).

checks.name: responsive-branded-shell-desktop
checks.evidence: At 1440x900: magazine-header, magazine-logo, all 5 nav links, and magazine-footer with logo + facebook/instagram/x/youtube social icons all visible.

action_items: No API-bearing UI criteria were identified in the acceptance matrix (Garage/Ownership/Pitstop/Membership are explicitly local prototype state per SPEC.md), so no backend pytest files were added this iteration — this is expected, not an omission.
